q15.

The three tables map to plain Go structs in the `store` package (this repo hand-writes SQL per driver rather than using an ORM, so the mapping is by driver queries, not struct tags):

| Table | Struct — path |
| --- | --- |
| `user` | `User` — `store/user.go` (line 29) |
| `attachment` | `Attachment` — `store/attachment.go` (line 16) |
| `reaction` | `Reaction` — `store/reaction.go` (line 7) |

The table association is confirmed by the driver implementations that read and write these structs: `store/db/postgres/user.go` and `store/db/mysql/user.go` query `"user"`/`` `user` ``, `store/db/postgres/attachment.go` queries `attachment`, and `store/db/postgres/reaction.go` (plus `store/db/sqlite/reaction.go`) queries `reaction`.
